title: 移除 BFF 重複的資料來源明文金鑰檢查（誤擋 secret_scope，畫面新增資料來源必 400）

error.message: Raw secret material detected at connector_config.secret_scope: inline secrets are strictly forbidden; use secret_ref_id

hosted_incident_2026_10_20.root_cause: services/control-plane/bff/console_gap/datasources.py maintained a duplicate assert_no_raw_secrets function using substring matching (any(kw in lower_k for kw in _SECRET_KEYWORDS)), which falsely flagged connector_config.secret_scope='runtime_read_only' because 'secret' is a substring of 'secret_scope'. The owner validator in services/source_ingestion/source_management_models.py uses exact key membership (_SUSPICIOUS_SECRET_KEYS).

resolution.bff_validation_change: Removed the BFF duplicate substring-matching assert_no_raw_secrets from services/control-plane/bff/console_gap/datasources.py and imported the owner assert_no_raw_secrets from services.source_ingestion.source_management_models.
resolution.response_redaction_preserved: Kept redact_sensitive_values in services/control-plane/bff/console_gap/datasources.py conservative with substring matching over _SECRET_KEYWORDS for responses and receipts.
